cards.name: Said // Done
cards.oracleText:
Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tap up to two target creatures. Those creatures don't untap during their controller's next untap step.

cards.name: Slip Out the Back
cards.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It phases out. (Treat it and anything attached to it as though they don't exist until its controller's next turn.)

cards.name: Unauthorized Exit
cards.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. Surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
